name: Graphimo
description: A live canvas view over marimo notebooks.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Inspect the live cells and dependencies of the selected marimo notebook.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List public callables in the selected notebook project's components folder.

tools.name: add_component
tools.description: Insert a readable Python cell calling a selected component.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Safely replace one simple component call input with an upstream variable.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Ask the active marimo session to run one cell.

tools.name: open_code
tools.description: Open the corresponding notebook in marimo's editor.
